lines.text: Elijah the Tishbite tells King Ahab that there will be neither dew nor rain except at his word.
The LORD sends Elijah to hide by the Brook of Kidron, where ravens bring him bread and meat morning and evening.
When the brook dries up, Elijah goes to Zarephath, where a widow gathering sticks says she has only a handful of flour and a little oil.
Elijah tells the widow to make him a small cake first, and her jar of flour and jug of oil never run out.
After the widow's son dies, Elijah carries him to the upper room, stretches over him five times, and the LORD restores his life.
